title: Detailed crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Crown base band -->
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='60' height='16' rx='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFE94D'/>
  <!-- Base band gems -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='78' r='4' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='4' fill='#3BC9FF'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='78' r='4' fill='#4DFF88'/>
  <!-- Base band lower shade -->
  <rect x='20' y='80' width='60' height='4' rx='2' fill='#D9A800'/>

  <!-- Left spike -->
  <polygon points='24,68 20,30 36,55' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='24,68 20,30 28,52' fill='#FFE94D'/>
  <!-- Left spike tip ball -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <circle cx='18.5' cy='26.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFA0B8'/>

  <!-- Middle spike (tallest) -->
  <polygon points='42,68 50,14 58,68' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='42,68 50,14 50,68' fill='#FFE94D'/>
  <!-- Middle tip ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='6' fill='#3BC9FF'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='11' r='2' fill='#B8F0FF'/>
  <!-- Middle spike gem -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='6' fill='#4DFF88'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='2' fill='#C4FFD9'/>

  <!-- Right spike -->
  <polygon points='76,68 80,30 64,55' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='76,68 80,30 72,52' fill='#FFE94D'/>
  <!-- Right spike tip ball -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <circle cx='78.5' cy='26.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFA0B8'/>

  <!-- Small side spikes -->
  <polygon points='20,68 34,50 37,68' fill='#E6C200'/>
  <polygon points='80,68 66,50 63,68' fill='#E6C200'/>

  <!-- Spike connecting arches -->
  <path d='M36 60 Q43 52 50 60' stroke='#FFE94D' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 60 Q57 52 64 60' stroke='#FFE94D' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Extra jewels on band top -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
</svg>
